flow: POST /bookings/quote returns the live price for the complete range.
POST /bookings/challenge requires a signed-in wallet and binds wallet, ledger account, GPU, UTC start and end, maximum payment, request ID, nonce and expiry.
The connected wallet signs messageHex without submitting a ledger transaction.
POST /bookings verifies the signature and consumes the approval atomically with its durable reservation journal. Compute reserves first. A validated payment confirms the booking.
Uncertain outcomes retain the hold and idempotency record. An identical signed retry returns a confirmed receipt or an explicit pending result. It never submits a second payment.
idempotencyHeader: Idempotency-Key must equal challengeId when supplied.
